pages.title: Breached Anomaly Engine
pages.text: Ruins of a machine that broke more than itself. Its frame is torn, and from the tears leak fragments of rules that no longer apply anywhere. It hums irregularly, and the space around it is not quite consistent.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I came upon it in the wreckage of a breach, still sputtering. Someone, maybe some earlier version of me, built an engine to break the axioms, and the axioms broke back.
